name: 05 AI Local Business Lead Intelligence & Outreach Pipeline

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "llama3",
  "prompt": "Write a short, friendly outreach message to the business below.

Business Name: {{ $('Clean Lead Data').item.json.name }}
Business Type: {{ $('Clean Lead Data').item.json.type }}
Website: {{ $('Clean Lead Data').item.json.website }}

You are an AI automation specialist reaching out to help them improve operations and increase bookings.

The message should:
- be 2–3 sentences
- sound natural and human
- NOT sound salesy or spammy
- suggest improving bookings, customer engagement, or reducing manual work
- NOT pretend to be the business
- NOT mention AI unless natural

Return ONLY the message text.",
  "stream": false
}
